ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 1258 de 2008 (SAS regime); Ley 222 de 1995 (corporate reform); Decreto 410 de 1971 (Codigo de Comercio); Ley 2120 de 2021 (Registro de Transparencia y Beneficiarios Finales - RTBF); Resolucion DIAN 164 de 2021 as amended by Resolucion DIAN 174 de 2022 (Registro Unico de Beneficiarios Finales - RUB); Ley 1121 de 2006 (AML/CFT framework); Circular Basica Juridica of the Superintendencia Financiera and Sarlaft sectoral guidance issued by the Superintendencia de Sociedades
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (confidential filing with DIAN/RUB; information is not publicly accessible and is used exclusively by tax, corporate, and AML supervisory authorities; nominee shareholders and legal representatives must disclose the natural-person ultimate beneficial owner)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille pursuant to the 1961 Apostille Convention; fallback to Consular Legalization at a Colombian consulate for non-member states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company Registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction (e.g., UK Companies House, U.S. Secretary of State, equivalent commercial register)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Apostilled Certified Copy of Valid Passport of each natural-person shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing passport authority or competent notarial authority in the shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Authenticated Private Incorporation Deed and Bylaws (documento de constitucion y estatutos) executed before a Colombian Notary and registered with the Chamber of Commerce
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notaria Publica in Colombia and Camara de Comercio del domicilio social

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified translation with translator's seal and signature authenticated as required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory negative screening of all shareholders, legal representatives, signatories, and ultimate beneficial owners against (i) OFAC SDN List, (ii) UN Security Council Consolidated List (Resolutions 1267/1989/2253 and 1373), (iii) EU consolidated financial sanctions list, and (iv) Colombian restrictive lists including the 'Lista Clinton', the SARLAFT-related lists, and the DIAN's binding blacklists. PEP status is determined per GAFILAT standards and Ley 1121 de 2006, covering domestic and foreign politically exposed persons with a 2-year cooling-off period after cessation of public functions. Enhanced due diligence (EDD) is mandatory for any PEP, including documentary verification of source of funds and source of wealth for the capital subscription, and for transactions involving high-risk third-country business partners. Nominee or intermediary shareholders triggering a 10% UBO link are prohibited absent full disclosure to the DIAN/RUB.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Ventanilla Unica Empresarial (VUE - www.vue.gov.co) and Registro Unico Empresarial y Social (RUES), administered by the Camara de Comercio del domicilio social (e.g., Camara de Comercio de Bogota)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All statutory corporate names must be entered in Spanish; foreign words are permissible solely when written in Latin-script characters and integrated into a grammatically Spanish-constructed denomination; every SAS name must conclude with the mandatory suffix 'S.A.S.'; non-Spanish documents must be accompanied by certified official translation before the Chamber registers them; transliteration follows standard Spanish phonetic rules.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banco, Banco de Inversion or any banking denomination (requires prior approval from the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia)
Aseguradora, Companhia de Seguros, Reaseguradora (requires prior financial supervisory authorization)
Cooperativa, Fondo de Empleados, Asociacion Mutual (requires prior authorization from the Superintendencia de Economia Solidaria)
Fondo de Pensiones, Cesantias, Administradora de Fondos (requires prior supervisory license)
Bolsa de Valores, Central de Valores, Comisionista de Bolsa (sensitive financial market tokens)
Nacion, Republica de Colombia, Gobierno Nacional, Presidencia de la Republica, Ministerio de ..., Gobernacion, Alcaldia (state authority tokens)
Congreso de la Republica, Corte Constitucional, Corte Suprema de Justicia, Consejo de Estado (judicial/legislative institutional tokens)
Fuerzas Militares de Colombia, Policia Nacional de Colombia, Ejercito Nacional (military and public-order tokens)
Fundacion or Corporacion (reserved exclusively for nonprofit legal forms, prohibited for a for-profit SAS)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant must file a written 'recurso de reposicion' directly with the issuing Camara de Comercio within 10 working days of the rejection notice; if the Chamber denies the reconsideration, the applicant may escalate a 'recurso de apelacion' to the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) within 10 working days of the unfavorable decision. The appeal must attach the original rejection certificate, the proposed corrected name, and explanations of the distinguishing elements. Deadlines are per Ley 1437 de 2011 (Codigo de Procedimiento Administrativo y de lo Contencioso Administrativo); alternatively, the applicant may file a fresh homonymy request with a revised name. Judicial annulment recourse (accion de nulidad y restablecimiento del derecho) before the Consejo de Estado may be pursued within four months of the final administrative act.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual and coworking office addresses are generally accepted by the Colombian Chambers of Commerce as the formal 'domicilio social' for a SAS, provided the address is a genuine, accessible mail-reception point within the municipal jurisdiction and the relevant Chamber confirms availability of the address. However, the actual commercial substance of the CO2 laser cutting and wooden puzzle assembly operation requires a separate physical industrial or light-manufacturing premises duly approved under municipal land-use rules, fire-safety and environmental regulations. A virtual office cannot be used to substitute the physical operating facility, to avoid municipal Industria y Comercio (ICA) taxation, or to misrepresent tax residence before the DIAN.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate-Low quantified risk: approximately 20% likelihood of an unannounced regulatory inspection during the first 12 months of operation. This is driven by DIAN VAT-registration validation visits, RUES compliance checks, municipal ICA enrollment reviews, and sanitary/safety visits triggered by operation of Class-4 laser equipment. Under the Codigo de Comercio and the Estatuto Tributario, DIAN and Chamber inspectors may conduct unannounced on-site verifications without prior notice.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (S.A.S. regime), Articles 1, 4, 5, 17, 19, 20, 21 and 40; Código de Comercio, Articles 110 and 353-372; Decreto Único Reglamentario 1074 de 2015, Title 2, Chapter 1; applicable DIAN or Chamber regulations on CIIU 3240 and beneficial-owner reporting.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (territorially competent Chamber of Commerce), using the national Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) online portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation instrument) authenticated when required, or Escritura Pública (public deed) solely if real-property assets are contributed to the S.A.S.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital under Law 1258/2008; capital is freely set by the shareholders and may be paid in installments over a maximum of two years. No escrow or mandatory bank deposit is imposed by Colombian law; escrow applies only if the shareholders voluntarily adopt such rule in the by-laws. At least one share must be subscribed and paid at incorporation in accordance with Article 17.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION NO. 1. The incorporated shareholder of [COMPANY] S.A.S., under Article 19 of Law 1258 of 2008, resolves: FIRST, to approve the incorporation instrument and the subscription of one hundred (100) common shares by the founding shareholder, subscribed and paid as recorded in the by-laws. SECOND, to adopt the registered office at [ADDRESS], [CITY], and to authorize the legal representative to execute all lease and notarial acts. THIRD, to appoint [NAME] as Legal Representative with powers to sign contracts, open bank accounts, and file tax returns. FOURTH, to instruct the representative to obtain all industrial and environmental permits before starting operations. The resolutions enter into force immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name availability search and drafting of the S.A.S. by-laws
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social, online RUES portal (www.rues.org.co)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed corporate name for approval and obtain the homonym certificate. Draft the Documento Privado de Constitución containing all mandatory S.A.S. clauses: corporate purpose covering ISIC 3240 wooden puzzle laser assembly, duration, capital schedule, representation powers, dispute-resolution rules, and audit provisions. The name availability certificate is valid for 90 calendar days.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name and two alternatives
Identification documents of each shareholder
Draft incorporation instrument and by-laws
Power of attorney if a shareholder is represented
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, select an alternative name or submit an objection to the Chamber; a corrected homonym certificate may be issued without restarting the incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and authentication of the incorporation instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública when notarization is required or real property is contributed; otherwise the executing shareholders and the Chamber's legalization officer.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Have all shareholders or their attorney-in-fact sign the Documento Privado de Constitución. If any shareholder contributes real property, formalize by public deed before a notary. Authenticate signatures if the Chamber or the parties so require. Record the subscription and payment status of each share in the capital schedule and obtain the legal representative's acceptance.
required_dossiers: Final draft of the S.A.S. incorporation instrument
Certificate of name availability
Shareholder identification or passport copies
Notarial execution sheet or power of attorney
Capital payment evidence or deferred-payment schedule
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or Chamber raises clarity issues, prepare a correction instrument or amendment sheet and re-execute it before the same authority within 10 business days; the filing date of the original document is preserved if corrections are procedural.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Merchant registration and issuance of Chamber certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social through RUES or the physical registry window.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed incorporation instrument together with the Chamber registration forms. Pay the applicable registration tariff and complete the registration questionnaire. The Chamber will register the company, assign the provisional NIT, and issue the Certificado de Cámara de Comercio evidencing the company's existence and the legal representative's powers.
required_dossiers: Executed incorporation instrument
Certificate of name availability
Completed Chamber registration forms
Letter of acceptance from the property owner for the registered office
Payment receipt for registration tariff
Identification and acceptance of the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber files an observation, submit the corrected instrument and forms within 15 calendar days; timely correction maintains the original filing date and avoids re-running the full procedure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax registration before DIAN and obtaining the final NIT/RUT
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales, online via Muisca (www.muisca.dian.gov.co)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using the provisional NIT issued by the Chamber, complete the Registro Único Tributario online. Select CIIU code 3240 for the manufacture of games and toys and declare the expected e-commerce sales channels. Obtain the legal representative's electronic signature and password for future tax and customs filings. DIAN will consolidate the final NIT after verifications.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Cámara de Comercio
Provisional NIT confirmation
Legal representative's identification and contact details
Registered office address and lease evidence
Bank account information for tax refunds
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN issues an observation on the RUT, file an electronic correction through Muisca within 10 business days. If the electronic signature is blocked, request reactivation at a DIAN service point with the legal representative's original identification.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – www.dian.gov.co; electronic proceedings via MUISCA (Modelo Único de Ingresos, Servicio y Control Automatizado) at muisca.dian.gov.co and the DIAN Sede Electrónica.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Colombian S.A.S.: (1) a Colombian lawyer empowered by the foreign shareholders prepares the private constitutive document (documento privado de constitución) – a notarial deed is not mandatory unless real estate is contributed; (2) register the S.A.S. with the Cámara de Comercio in the Registro Único Empresarial (RUES), which triggers assignment of a provisional NIT; (3) the Cámara de Comercio forwards the data to DIAN, and the legal representative completes the mandatory RUT (Registro Único Tributario) filing through DIAN's virtual portal, declaring the economic activity (ISIC 3240) and the 'responsable de IVA' and 'exportador' statuses; (4) DIAN validates the file and issues the definitive NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria). The process takes 3–10 business days. No minimum paid-in capital is required; a certified accountant is required, and a fiscal auditor (revisor fiscal) is mandatory only if the S.A.S. exceeds statutory asset/revenue thresholds. After the NIT is active, the company must register with an authorized e-invoicing software provider for the Facturación Electrónica system.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation; Territorial_Scope: Worldwide residence-based taxation. A Colombian S.A.S. is a resident corporation under Article 12 E.T.; Colombian law does not recognize US-style check-the-box pass-through treatment for an S.A.S. Corporate income tax rate: 35% for taxable years 2023–2025, decreasing to 30% from 2026 (Law 2277/2022, Art. 240 E.T.). Dividends paid to non-residents are subject to withholding tax at the source.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia has no US-style check-the-box election. Available statutory mechanisms: (i) election to opt into the Régimen Simple de Tributación (SIMPLE), a consolidated tax regime (income tax, VAT and other levies at progressive rates of 1.8%–14.5%) for eligible S.A.S. entities with gross income up to 3,500 UVT (≈ COP 164.7 million, UVT 2024 = COP 47,065) for services, or up to 100,000 UVT for industry/commerce activities; such election is made through the RUT and is generally irrevocable for a two-year biennial period; (ii) RUT classification elections regarding VAT status, with mandatory treatment as 'Responsable del Régimen Común' for any S.A.S. selling taxable goods (including exports); (iii) ordinary-income taxpayer elections on depreciation, inventory cost methods, and deduction subsystems within the general regime — not elective for pass-through purposes; (iv) anti-hybrid compliance: under Article 61-4 E.T., taxpayers involved in hybrid mismatch arrangements (e.g., disregarded payments or dual-resident structures) must disclose such structures in the annual informative filing to DIAN; Colombian tax law refuses to recognize foreign reverse-hybrid treatment for a Colombian S.A.S., which is always taxed at the entity level.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA – Impuesto sobre las Ventas (Colombian VAT / general sales tax on goods and services), administered by DIAN under the Estatuto Tributario (E.T.), Arts. 420 onward.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No economic turnover threshold applies to a corporate S.A.S.: VAT registration is mandatory from the first taxable transaction regardless of amount. An S.A.S. is always a 'Responsable del Régimen Común' and must be enrolled in the RUT before beginning operations. For natural persons only, the simplified VAT regime may apply up to gross income of 3,500 UVT (COP 164,727,500 for 2024); this option is not available to S.A.S. entities. Export sales (including e-commerce exports of wooden puzzles) remain subject to mandatory VAT registration even where the headline rate is 0% on the export.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time e-invoicing: every VAT-responsible taxpayer must issue the Factura Electrónica de Venta (FEV) through DIAN-certified software (or DIAN's free 'Facturación VUE' tool) under Resolución DIAN 165/2023. The FEV must be transmitted electronically to DIAN via HTTPS/API web services (MUISCA) at the moment of sale (Validación Previa). DIAN validates the FEV against the RUT and assigns a unique CUFE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica) and a QR code; the electronic invoice XML must be delivered to the customer. For exports, the FEV must reference the export customs declaration (DEX) and the prior export authorization (autorización de salida) issued through MUISCA. The recipient must digitally confirm receipt/rejection of the FEV. Non-compliance triggers fines of up to 5% of the invoice value (Art. 652-1 E.T.), voiding of improperly issued invoices for tax deduction purposes, and temporary business closure of 3–10 days (Art. 657 E.T.).

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A sale of goods physically exported from Colombian customs territory (e.g., HS 9503 wooden 3D puzzles) is zero-rated (0% IVA) under Article 481 E.T. Conditions: (i) the S.A.S. is registered in the RUT as a VAT-responsible taxpayer and an 'exportador'; (ii) the export is covered by a valid automated export declaration (DEX) approved by DIAN through MUISCA, and the goods actually leave Colombian territory; (iii) the FEV with CUFE is issued for the export sale; (iv) the proceeds are received in foreign currency from abroad and repatriated through the Colombian foreign exchange market. Input VAT embedded in export-related purchases (raw wood, laser consumables, packaging, logistics) is recoverable; exporters may claim periodic refunds or offset the IVA balance via DIAN's refund/compensation procedure (Art. 481 and 855-860 E.T.).
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: DEX – Declaración de Exportación: DIAN-validated export declaration obtained through MUISCA, containing the autorización de salida and the export certificate for non-reimbursable operations if applicable
FEV – Factura Electrónica de Venta: mandatory electronic sales invoice (XML with CUFE and QR) referencing the DEX and, where possible, the Amazon marketplace order or Stripe transaction reference
Bill of Lading (B/L) or Air Waybill (AWB): transport document evidencing shipment from Colombia and entry of the goods into the foreign destination country
Commercial invoice, packing list and certificate of origin (for any trade-agreement preference), and product safety/quality documentation (e.g., EN 71 or ASTM F963) where required by the importer

Certificado de Reintegro de Divisas: inward foreign-currency remittance certificate issued by the local intermediary bank in Colombia, evidencing that export proceeds were channeled through the Colombian foreign exchange market (Mercado Cambiario)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN and the customs authority audit zero-rating claims by cross-matching the DEX, FEV, customs manifests, logistics tracking, and FX remittance certificates. If the taxpayer fails to prove actual export or fails to repatriate export proceeds within 180 days, the 0% treatment is retroactively clawed back: the S.A.S. must self-assess and pay the 19% VAT on the invoiced export amount, plus daily default interest computed under Art. 635 E.T. (based on 1.5× the certified current bank lending rate). The inaccuracy penalty (sanción por inexactitud under Art. 648 E.T., as amended by Law 2277/2022) may reach 160% of the omitted IVA; further customs penalties for false declarations range from 50% to 200% of the customs value of the goods (Decreto 390/2016). Repeated or fraudulent schemes may result in suspension of the RUT exporter status, seizure of in-transit goods, criminal prosecution for aggravated tax evasion with imprisonment of 48–108 months (Código Penal, Arts. 402–403), and fines under Colombia's foreign-exchange regime of up to 200% of the non-repatriated amount (Superintendencia Financiera).

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la Republica de Colombia (Central Bank of Colombia), Board of Directors; Foreign-exchange administration is implemented through authorized intermediaries (commercial banks and exchange houses) under supervision of the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC). Core legal framework: Ley 9 de 1991, Decreto 1735 de 1993, Resolucion Externa 8 de 2000 of the Banco de la Republica, Circular Reglamentaria Externa DCIN-83, and DIAN regulations for customs-linked exchange declarations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a managed floating exchange-rate regime. Current-account transactions (goods, services, interest, royalties) are fully convertible and freely channeled through the mercado cambiario. Capital-account transactions are liberalized but mandatory-channeling applies: all foreign-currency inflows and outflows must pass through authorized FX intermediaries and be declared to the Central Bank via the bank-issued Declaracion de Cambio. Foreign direct investment (FDI) in a manufacturing S.A.S. requires no prior governmental authorization but must be registered with the Banco de la Republica before dividends, capital repatriation, or liquidation proceeds can be legally remitted abroad. Profit-remittance hurdles are procedural rather than approval-based: the foreign investment must be timely registered, the local entity must evidence profits through filed financial statements, and dividend withholding tax must be settled with DIAN. Shareholder loans are legally permissible but since December 2022 are exposed to the Central Bank reserve requirement on external credit (encaje sobre endeudamiento externo), making registered equity contributions the structurally preferred treasury route.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds from goods, including e-commerce parcel sales settled through Amazon Pay and Stripe, constitute current-account exchange obligations. The exporter must collect and channel 100% of the export value through the foreign-exchange market via an authorized intermediary within 6 months from the date of shipment (customs export declaration DEX). The Banco de la Republica may grant a single extension of up to 12 months in justified cases. There is no fixed percentage mandatory surrender to the Central Bank; the exporter may convert the foreign currency to COP at market rate or maintain the funds in a registered foreign-currency compensation account (cuenta de compensacion) in Colombia or abroad, but the funds must remain within the Colombian FX-reporting system and be declared to the intermediary within the statutory deadline. The supporting declaration is the Declaracion de Cambio por Exportaciones, accompanied by the DEX, invoices, platform settlement reports, and shipping/tracking evidence.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules_extra: For low-value parcel exports using express courier channels, simplified customs and FX declaration procedures may apply, but the 6-month channeling obligation persists. The exporter must keep fully reconcilable records between the export declaration and the marketplace payout to avoid under-invoicing or late-reintegration penalties.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority_confirmed: Banco de la Republica de Colombia
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_rating: Current account: fully convertible; Capital account: liberalized with mandatory channeling and post-investment registration. Profit remittance permitted once FDI registration is complete.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.profit_remittance_hurdle_note: Dividends and branch profits remitted to non-resident shareholders are subject to Colombian dividend withholding tax and require: (i) registered foreign investment, (ii) audited/tax-filed financial statements evidencing distributable profit, (iii) corporate act of distribution, and (iv) pending tax compliance certification. Repatriation of registered capital is allowed without additional authorization once the FDI registration and exchange declarations are aligned.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Current Account (Cuenta Corriente) + USD Compensation Account (Cuenta de Compensacion) + Foreign Trade Settlement Module
Operational Current Account + Capital Escrow Collection Account (Cuenta de Capitalizacion) for FDI injections
Corporate Operational Account + Cross-Border Trade Finance and FX Derivative Account
Operational Current Account (digital onboarding supported) + Export Settlement Account
Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente/Ahorros) + Domestic ACH-PSE Treasury Rails

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW as a primary treasury rail and MEDIUM only as an auxiliary collection channel. Offshore digital EMIs (Wise, Payoneer, Airwallex, etc.) are not licensed Colombian financial intermediaries: they cannot hold COP-nominated accounts, cannot receive funds in the Colombian banking system, and cannot discharge the mandatory FX channeling, export-proceeds reintegration, or Central Bank declaration obligations. Their lawful auxiliary function is limited to receiving USD trade payouts abroad; those funds must then be transferred into the S.A.S.'s account at an authorized Colombian bank within the statutory 6-month export window, with the underlying export documentation attached. Locally SFC-licensed electronic payment institutions (companias de financiamiento / payment wallets) may provide collection rails (PSE, card acquirers, digital wallets) but are not substitutes for a full corporate treasury relation, FX declaration capability, or trade-finance products.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A face-to-face or bank-approved biometric-secure videoconference KYC interview is practically mandatory for the S.A.S. legal representative and must cover the ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs). Colombian banks generally require the presence of the principal legal representative at the branch, or of a locally appointed attorney-in-fact holding a notarized power of attorney legalized by apostille and translated to Spanish. A 100% non-resident board without any local compliance liaison will face enhanced due diligence and in most banks will be rejected for remote-only opening. Mandatory documentary package: NIT (tax ID) certificate, Certificado de Camara de Comercio (issued within the last 30 days), company by-laws (estatutos), due incorporation filing, UBO questionnaire (Formato de Beneficiario Final), SARLAFT/AML questionnaire, and proof of operational address in Colombia.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: 100% foreign-owned S.A.S. with non-resident legal representatives and an opaque or multi-tiered holding chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificado de Camara de Comercio (fresh, 30 days); apostilled certificate of incorporation and good-standing of the direct shareholder; complete corporate ownership chart to ultimate natural persons; passport copies with apostille; UIAF/UBO declaration forms; tax-residence certificates of the shareholders; source-of-funds evidence comprising audited financial statements and clean investor bank statements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Marketplace payout pattern from Amazon Pay and Stripe showing split settlements, refunds, currency conversions, and volatility inconsistent with the declared wooden-puzzle manufacturing activity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed seller agreements with Amazon and Stripe; merchant ID verification letters; granular settlement/payout reports reconciled to the entity sales ledger; DEX export declarations for the corresponding shipments; courier and customs tracking evidence; DIAN e-invoicing records; product catalog and commercial photographs of the CO2 laser-cutting facility.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money-laundering red flags: prepayments to suppliers in high-risk jurisdictions or payments to intermediate-country nominee accounts (e.g., Chinese wood or laser-tube purchases routed through Hong Kong or Singapore)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete supplier due-diligence file (commercial contract, purchase order, proforma invoice); independent inspection certificates (SGS/Bureau Veritas or similar); transport documents (bill of lading / airway bill); coherent incoterms and valuation supporting the DIAN import declaration; arm's-length transfer-pricing documentation aligned with Colombian TP rules; bank-filed Declaracion de Cambio por Importaciones matching the customs declaration.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large lump-sum inbound capital injection into a newly incorporated, low-capital S.A.S. immediately followed by rapid outbound transfers (pass-through or layering typology)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized capital-contribution minutes (acta de aportes) registered at the Camara de Comercio; investor-side bank statement evidencing the withdrawal and transaction trail; timely filing of the foreign-investment registration with Banco de la Republica via the intermediary; detailed business plan showing use of funds (CO2 laser machines, raw wood inventory, payroll, warehouse lease); board resolutions authorizing each benchmark transaction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity in-and-out foreign-currency movements or serial related-party payments without visible operational substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Segregated treasury structure with one dedicated account per purpose; approved board resolutions and transfer-pricing master file; monthly operational and inventory reconciliations; warehouse/logistics agreements evidencing physical production and export flows; audited financial statements demonstrating margin coherence with the wooden-puzzle cost structure; periodic SARLAFT self-assessment and compliance attestation.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Preferred rail: equity FDI via SWIFT MT103 wire from the non-resident investor to the S.A.S. operational account at an authorized Colombian bank, with the bank instructed to classify the receipt as 'Inversiones Internacionales - Aportes de Capital' in the mandatory Declaracion de Cambio. The intermediary transmits the exchange declaration to Banco de la Republica and the investor/entity files the Registro de Inversiones Internacionales through the bank within the statutory term, attaching the NIT, corporate resolutions, and certificate of existence. Completion of registration unlocks lawful dividend remittances and capital repatriation. Alternative rail: shareholder loans, which require a formal cross-border loan agreement, arm's-length interest, registration in the external-debt information system, and mandatory compliance with the in-force encaje (reserve requirement) on external credit; subordination documentation is advisable to prevent re-characterization as equity. For all routes, the wire must be tagged with the beneficiary NIT and the precise FX purpose code to avoid misposting as a service payment.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Production-input payments: supplier prepayments and open-account remittances via SWIFT MT103 tied to the DIAN import declaration (Declaracion de Importacion) and the bank foreign-trade module; documentary collections (remesas documentarias) on shipment; irrevocable commercial Letters of Credit under UCP 600 for bulk MDF/wood procurement, with presentation conforming to invoice, packing list, bills of lading, and ISPM-15 phytosanitary certificate for raw wood. All foreign disbursements are filed as exchange declarations for imports ('Importacion de Bienes'). E-commerce inbound settlements: Stripe and Amazon Pay USD payouts land on the S.A.S. registered USD compensation account and are declared as export proceeds using the platform settlement report as documentary support. Domestic COP disbursements (wages, utilities, taxes, local wood purchases) run over ACH-CUD and PSE debit rails, keeping VAT and withholding flows visible to DIAN.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable OTC COP/USD forward contracts with licensed Colombian banks, referenced to the TRM (Tasa Representativa del Mercado), used to lock export-receivable conversion rates for up to 12 months.
COP/USD FX swaps and cross-currency interest-rate swaps linked to underlying trade or external-credit obligations, executed through authorized intermediaries.

Standardized FX derivatives (forwards, futures, options) traded on the Mercado de Derivados Estandarizados (MDE) operated under Banco de la Republica rules and cleared by the Camara de Riesgo Central de Contraparte (CRCC).
OTC currency options purchased from Colombian banks for downside protection on USD e-commerce payouts, with premia paid through the local FX market.

Non-deliverable forward (NDF) structures: permissible only for genuine hedging purposes when arranged through an authorized onshore bank or its offshore branch and reflected in exchange declarations; unregistered offshore NDF positions are not a permitted treasury instrument for a Colombian resident S.A.S.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Commercial Registry Renewal (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce) where the SAS has its registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing surcharge of 6% of the renewal fee per month up to 31 May, plus daily interest; after 31 May, the registry registration can be cancelled and the entity risks administrative strike-off, losing its legal personality.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Return (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Varies annually based on the last two digits of the company's NIT; typically between August 15 and October 15 for the prior fiscal year (e.g., year 2 tax return due in September/October of year 1)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to 5% of the tax assessed per month or fraction, minimum of 10 UVT, plus daily interest; failure to file for an extended period may result in administrative assessment and asset liens.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Approval and Filing of Financial Statements (Estados Financieros de Propósito General)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders' General Meeting / Cámara de Comercio (with annual renewal or separate filing where applicable)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders' meeting or unanimous written consent by March 31; filing with the Chamber of Commerce within 30 days of approval, generally no later than April 30
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing of financial statements with the Chamber of Commerce may attract a fine per the Commercial Code (up to 2% of the company's assets or a fixed amount) and delay renewal of the commercial registry.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due annually generally between April and May of the following fiscal year, depending on the resolution and NIT schedule
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or incorrect filing is subject to a fine of up to 15,000 UVT (approximately USD 40,000), reduced to 10% of the value if not reported, with possibility of strike-off penalty only in extreme aggregate cases.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN – using official form / through the FTRA platform
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, within the same month as the income tax return due date; for the fiscal year, the deadline follows the NIT based schedule (often in September/October)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing or false information incurs a fine of up to 10,000 UVT (approximately USD 27,000), and may affect subsequent registry renewals.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Colombian SAS is mandatory to have a statutory auditor (Revisor Fiscal) if: (a) on the prior December 31, total gross assets exceed 5,000 times the monthly statutory minimum wage (approx. USD 1.6 million) or gross revenue exceeds 3,000 times the monthly minimum wage (approx. USD 1.0 million); or (b) the company is subject to public interest rules, securities issuance, or certain regulated activities. Otherwise, no independent audit is required but shareholders may voluntarily appoint one.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian GAAP under Decree 2420 of 2015 (as amended), applying IFRS for SMEs (NIIF para las PYMES) for Group 2 entities; full IFRS if the company is a large enterprise.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SAS must file an annual beneficial owner report to the DIAN using the established format (connected with the income tax return). Additionally, any changes in shareholding or UBO during the year must be updated in the Commercial Registry at the Chamber of Commerce at the time of the annual renewal. The Register of Members must reflect every transfer of shares within 30 days.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Register of Directors and Legal Representatives (Libro de Registro de Junta Directiva y Representantes)
Minute Book – Shareholders’ Meetings (Libro de Actas de Asamblea de Accionistas)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 1,500-4,500 (only if mandatory or voluntary; based on a small SAS with limited transaction volume)
